ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, May 3, 2021 and to the campus on Monday, May 10, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is a core course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
